role_boundary.reviewer: Actual non-author to be confirmed after RB admission; destination identity and lightweight research activity must be real.
role_boundary.shared_context: Shared parent-task control context is disclosed; no clean/blind independence claim.

questions: Verify Q2 and C2 as finite polynomial congruences modulo p^2, including low-degree equality, high-tail p valuations, and typed substitutions.
Check CM0 before dividing by p; retain SIMPLE when a reciprocal is used; verify derivative/slope sign and t-unit transport.
Check the Chisholm Theorem 1 d=3 specialization, CM discriminant/inertness/good reduction and exact prime scope.
Check Borwein N=2, s=1/6, G^-24=1/2 and b_s/a_s=6 from the named primary pages; clearly mark any unverified source input.
Compare all six current Sun outputs, especially adjacent-value elimination and the exact-obstruction alternative; a scalar result does not discharge missing outputs.
Check QTF3's distinct address/normalization and p^3 precision, and preserve old LIFT/R_p obligations.
read_scope: Start from three frozen candidate inputs and packet section 4.
Consume CM0/SIMPLE and original 77-prime record as explicit inherited inputs; open exact proof only for one identified dependency or defect.
Primary sources are triggered only by the corresponding six review points; record successful reads and any source-access limit.

output.report: One short source-pinned reference report with reviewer identity/activity, exact bytes read, per-point conclusion, concrete corrections or qualified pass, and all limitations.
output.provenance: Preserve actual connector readbacks/hashes and externally persist report plus minimal manifest before return.
output.not_required: No new computation, consumer, LIFT proof, formal Result or formal Driver review.

stop_rules: Do not rerun the old 77-prime checks.
Do not infer a minimal obstruction from missing proof.
Do not combine the two distinct parent tasks.
Do not count paper T0/T6 reuse as native BRC execution.
Do not treat source publication or qualified advisory pass as formal acceptance.
